candidates.title: openai: /v1/responses silently drops developer-role input items (200, no error)
candidates.snippet: ### What is the issue?  `POST /v1/responses` accepts input items with `"role": "developer"`, returns `200` with `"status": "completed"` and no `error`, but the content of those items never reaches the model. The same text delivered as `system` or `user` is honoured.  The failure is entirely silent. candidates.title: 500 "no user query found in messages" for tool-only turns on /v1/messages and /v1/chat/completions (no truncation required)
candidates.snippet: ### What is the issue?  When the `messages` in a request contain **no user text turn**, ollama returns HTTP 500 `no user query found in messages` on both compatibility endpoints. The minimal case is a single standard agentic tool round: an assistant `tool_use` turn followed by a user turn carrying only the tool output (`tool_result` on `/v1/messages`, `role:"tool"` on `/v1/chat/completions`).
